items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I was there on the road with Lil Armstrong.

ctx.x: I -- remember I'm coming in from Buffalo. I left Lil. I was there on the road with Lil Armstrong. We came in that winter to play the Apollo Theater. I think that winter, here in New York with Chick, it was an amateur show going on. That's when they heard Ella.
Because when I went on the road with Lil Armstrong that -- when I came back from off that trip in '36, that's when I joined --
